welcome: Welcome to TunaOS Welcome. This assistant will guide you through installing TunaOS onto this computer. You will choose a target disk and a few options, and create your account. Nothing is written to any disk until you confirm on the last step. Get started
disk: Select a disk Everything on the disk you pick will be erased. Samsung SSD 870 EVO 500GB /dev/sda · 465.8 GiB · SATA Extreme SSD /dev/sdc · 931.5 GiB · USB Cruzer Blade /dev/sdd · 59.6 GiB · USB WD_BLACK SN850X 1000GB /dev/nvme0n1 · 953.9 GiB · NVMe Back Continue
options: Options Sensible defaults are already chosen. Change them only if you need to. System Computer name tunaos Filesystem xfs Encryption Disk encryption Passphrase You'll type it at every boot. Passphrase Required to unlock at boot Confirm passphrase Type it again Back Continue
account: Create your account You will sign in with this account. It can administer the computer. Account Username alex Full name Alex Example Password Required Confirm password Type it again Back Continue
confirm: Confirm installation The last screen before anything is written. Everything on /dev/sda will be erased. This cannot be undone.
